Implements **P0.02** (`docs/tickets/02_P0.02__contracts-and-data-model.md`) — the one shared decision the whole build hangs on. Stacked on the P0.01 branch.

## Summary
`@rhema/contracts` becomes the owner of **every shared name** (enum values, artifact kinds, sidecar shapes, event types, the visibility policy table, the canonical vocabularies). `@rhema/db` lands the **§11 schema** as forward-only SQL migrations with the in-Postgres invariants, RLS, and a seed built from the three real projects. Every later ticket consumes these; none re-declares them.

## What changed
**`packages/contracts`** — canonical vocab + Appendix D.2 reserved/banned data; the closed **63-value `ArtifactKind`** enum + the §8.2 `artifactPolicy` table; domain schemas (`Anchor` verbatim, claims/`claim_sources`, findings/dispositions, revision obligations); the **six sidecar schemas**; §12.5 run events (visibility split + 280-char bound); `notes.ts` templates; the analytics catalogue (design/9 §7.2 + REQ-BETA-6…12); `FindingView`/`GateView`. P0.01's placeholder vocab (`starter`/`pro`, `Deep`, `researcher`/`harness`) corrected to spec values (REQ-IDE-50); the one consumer (`protocols-stub`) updated.

**`packages/db`** — forward-only SQL migrations for every §11.4 table; the immutability trigger, the obligation-transition trigger, the one-working-head index; the `backlog_items → source='agenda'` migration then drop; RLS `FORCE` + `SET LOCAL` wrapper + limited `collab`/harvester roles; a Drizzle schema over the migrations (parity-tested); the code seed (`agent_types`, `protocols`) + the three-real-project seed.

**tooling** — `no-raw-set-tenant` lint rule (REQ-DATA-4); CI `contracts` job now runs the contract + db suites.

## Design decisions
- **PGlite for the deterministic DB ACs.** `@electric-sql/pglite` is a real Postgres compiled to WASM (plpgsql triggers, RLS `FORCE` + non-owner roles + `SET LOCAL`), so the immutability/obligation triggers and two-tenant RLS isolation run as ordinary in-process CI unit tests — no DB service. The migrator/seed are engine-agnostic (`{exec,query}`), so the same code runs against real Aurora.
- **Migrations are authoritative DDL** (REQ-DATA-3); the Drizzle schema is the typed query layer, kept honest by a reflection **parity test**.
- **Denormalized `workspace_id`** on the RLS-core tables gives one uniform tenant policy (`workspace_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id')`), set only through the `withTenant` wrapper.
- The global banned-strings lint stays narrow to non-colliding phrases; the full Appendix D.2 lint against the i18n table is bedrock data here, extended by later UI tickets.

## Verification
- `pnpm turbo build lint typecheck` — 75 tasks green. `pnpm test` — **130 tests green**.
- No live runtime surface (contracts + schema); PGlite exercises the real DB behavior.
